Up around 10. I didn't feel ill which was a shocker since I didn't so many shots last night of vodka with a couple of ouzo mixed in. After another wonderful breakfast I took an hour nap. Damn I needed it. By the time I got up at 12:30 and took a shower our ATVs were ready and we headed out.

We first stopped by the black sand beach and admired the blue ocean water against the black sand and the cliffs. The sand was incredibly hot so we ran into the ocean for a quick dip. Then we relaxed and had some beer and needed some nutrition. We all shared Greek food for lunch which was amazing, we haven't had any bad food so far. After lunch I felt my food/alcohol limit was fast approaching. I might need to do an activity tomorrow so I can eat more.

It was already 4 so were headed for the first winery we saw to buy drinks for the group. It was a beautiful winery but not as thrilling since we live in one of best wine regions in the world. We bought a container of boxed wine, yeah that's right boxed wine, and a couple bottles and headed back. We decided to stay in Santorini for our remaining time in Greece vs carrying all our luggage and trying to make the ferry to Hydra in time.

This was the last night we were all together. We chatted and drank and then had another amazing meal. Wig ate the remaining pork and lamb and they bought some fresh seabass from the market. They made a salad and risotto and it was amazing. Good times. They stayed up to play poker and I called it a night before midnight. I was out until Andy woke me up in a mosquito massacre. Bastards have been in our room the whole time.
